data.name: ConsentMessage
data.value:
When CashGear Capture crashes, it can send a report so the problem can be found and fixed.
A report has what went wrong and where in the app's code, the versions of the app and of Windows, and what the app did just before (its log, without names or details).
It never has screenshots, recordings, what you type, window titles, file names or passwords. You can change this in Settings › General › Privacy.
Send crash reports?

data.name: SendCrashReports
data.value: Send crash _reports when CashGear Capture crashes

data.name: CrashReportsHint
data.value: A report has the error and where in the app's code it happened, the app's and Windows' versions and the app's last log lines without names or details. Never screenshots, recordings, what you type, window titles, file names or passwords.

data.name: NoCrashReportAddress
data.value: This copy has no address to send crash reports to, so none are ever sent.
